טיפול בבריחת שתן- פיזיותרפיה ברצפת האגן: Treating urinary incontinence - pelvic floor physiotherapy for effective, fast treatment of urinary leakage
איך מתאפשרת למעשה ההתאפקות?: How does holding on actually work?
הסוגים השכיחים ביותר של דליפות השתן: The most common types of urinary leakage
אי נקיטת שתן משמעה איבוד בלתי נשלט של שת: Urinary incontinence means the uncontrolled loss of urine. It is a well-known and common medical problem, affecting on average one in two older women. The problem does not belong only to the golden years, as quite a few people believe; it can develop at any age, though the reasons usually differ between age groups. Although it is so common, many women with the problem avoid seeking treatment out of shame, helplessness or embarrassment, and sometimes for lack of knowledge, thinking urinary leakage is something that comes "with age". It is important to remember that every case of urinary leakage starts very small and gets worse gradually, until it affects quality of life, and emotional and social difficulties are added to the problem, such as staying at home, withdrawing from social activity, problems at work, and difficulties in the relationship and in sexual function. So it is best not to ignore the problem, but to seek treatment early and prevent it from getting worse. Dedicated absorbent products for urine and adult diapers help people manage day to day until the problem is treated.
באופן הפיזיולוגי הנורמלי, השתן הנוצר בכל: In normal physiology, the urine produced by the kidneys collects in the bladder. The bladder, made of involuntary muscle, is a storage organ – it holds the urine until the right place and time to empty. Normally, a healthy bladder should give us on average four hours of "quiet" from going to the toilet, so that altogether we empty about 7-8 times a day, at most once of them at night.
שרירי רצפת האגן, הנמצאים בתחתית האגן וסו: The pelvic floor muscles, at the bottom of the pelvis, close around the opening of the urethra. They are voluntary muscles = we can choose whether to contract or relax them. The pelvic floor muscles are linked through the nervous system to the bladder muscle, so by contracting or relaxing the pelvic floor muscles we can in fact control what the bladder does. While urine is being stored, or while we hold on, the bladder muscle is relaxed and the pelvic floor muscles are contracted, closing around the urethra; when we decide to urinate, the bladder muscle contracts and the pelvic floor muscles relax and let the urine out. Since storing and releasing urine is a complex process, the ability to control urination can be disrupted at any stage, for many reasons. The result of these disruptions is urinary leakage – loss of bladder control.
בריחת שתן המתרחשת בעקבות פעולות הגורמות: Urinary leakage that happens during actions that raise the pressure inside the abdomen. Examples of such actions: sneezing, coughing, laughing, dancing, running, walking, raising your voice and so on.
הדליפה מתרחשת משום ששרירי הבטן ושרירי רצ: The leakage happens because the abdominal and pelvic floor muscles – which should work together, on the one hand closing the urethra against the pressure that builds up and at the same time directing that pressure upward and regulating it – are not strong enough, so the pressure is directed at the bladder and urine is lost. The abdominal muscles play a large part in this teamwork with the pelvic floor muscles, so pelvic floor rehabilitation must also address how the abdominal muscles work.
&nbsp;דליפת שתן עקב שלפוחית רגיזה: Urinary leakage due to overactive bladder
במצב של שלפוחית רגיזה, שריר שלפוחית השתן: With an overactive bladder, the bladder muscle contracts involuntarily, even when the bladder fills with relatively small amounts of urine. In this condition the common complaints are urgency* and/or frequency**, and frequent urination at night (nocturia).
*דחיפות – צורך פתאומי עז להטיל שתן (עם א: *Urgency – a sudden, strong need to urinate (with or without urinary leakage)
**תכיפות – הטלת שתן בתדירות גבוהה במשך ה: **Frequency – urinating often during the day (more than 8 times a day)
ברוב המקרים לא יודעים להסביר מדוע מופיעה: In most cases it is not known why an overactive bladder appears, but it can often start after surgery in the abdomen or pelvis, an orthopedic injury to the legs, or an acute urinary tract infection.
על רקע משולב של שתי הסיבות הנ\"ל: Caused by a combination of the two reasons above
הטיפול הפיזיותרפי ברצפת האגן מסייע לטפל: Pelvic floor physiotherapy helps treat and prevent urinary incontinence.
טיפול בכאבים ברצפת האגן ובאגן- כאבים בפו: Treating pelvic and pelvic floor pain - vulvar / vaginal pain, penile pain and pain during intercourse
כאבים באיברי המין (הפרעות בתפקוד מיני) \: Genital pain (sexual dysfunction) / groin pain / pelvic floor pain
איך מסייע הטיפול הפיזיותרפי בכאבים ברצפת: How does physiotherapy help with pelvic floor pain?
מה מרגישים כשיש כאב ברצפת האגן?: What does pelvic floor pain feel like?
שרירי רצפת האגן קשורים קשר ישיר לתפקודנו: The pelvic floor muscles are directly linked to our sexual function – both to sexual arousal and during orgasm. Women or men with a dysfunction of, or pain in, these muscles may suffer from pain, discomfort or dysfunction in the pelvis, the pelvic floor or the lower back, and even from sexual dysfunction. The typical story of people in pain is one of deep loneliness within their ongoing pain (which usually lasts for years), alongside many medical investigations at the end of which no "real medical cause" was found for their symptoms.
הטיפול הפיזיותרפי בא לטפל במרכיב השרירי: Physiotherapy treats the muscular component and the soft tissues, in order to release them, bring the muscle tension and the tension in the painful tissues back to normal, and retrain correct motor function. Treatment also includes instructions for self-treatment and exercise, which complement the work in the clinic and help maintain the results. Restoring normal function to the pelvic floor tissues brings relief from pain, up to its complete disappearance.
באופן כללי, לכאב צורות הופעה רבות ומגוונ: In general, pain appears in many different forms – constant or on and off, during the day or at night, sitting or standing, on one side only or on both. It is often affected by, and gets worse with, emotional tension or stress, and in women it is also affected by the hormonal changes at different times of the menstrual cycle.
הכאב יכול להיות מורגש בפתח הנרתיק או בעו: The pain may be felt at the vaginal opening or deep inside, in the genital area, the rectum, the tailbone, the lower abdomen, the hips, the lower back, around the bladder, in the groin or around the clitoris. In women, as in men, there may be urinary problems (pain, discomfort or burning when urinating, urinary urgency, difficulty urinating, a weak stream or incomplete emptying), problems emptying the bowels up to severe constipation, and on the sexual side – pain, up to being completely unable to have intercourse, or pain afterwards.
הכאב יכול להיות מורגש באזור איבר המין –: The pain may be felt in the genital area – the penis, the perineum (the area between the testicles and the anus), the rectum, the anus, around the bladder, in the groin, the lower abdomen, the hips, the lower back or the tailbone. Alongside the pain there may also be urinary problems, such as discomfort, pain or burning when urinating, urinary urgency, a weak urine stream, frequent urination at night, or problems and difficulties emptying the bowels up to severe constipation. In sexual function there may be discomfort during or after ejaculation, and sometimes also problems getting or keeping an erection.
יש סיבות רבות אפשריות לכאב ולתפקוד לקוי: There are many possible causes of pelvic floor pain and dysfunction, among them: disturbed or impaired muscle function ("tight" or painful muscles), disturbed natural movement between the soft tissues and the connective tissues, injuries from trauma to the area – such as childbirth or a direct injury, scars, increased irritability of the nerves supplying the pelvic floor, and more. All of these can reduce blood flow to the pelvic floor muscles and cause irritability of the tissues, as well as painful points in the muscle (trigger points), which can themselves refer pain to different areas in the pelvis or beyond it.
טיפול בצניחת איברי רצפת האגן - צניחת שלפ: Treating pelvic organ prolapse - bladder prolapse, uterine prolapse and more
אילו תחושות מרגישים כשיש צניחה של איברי: What does pelvic organ prolapse feel like?
מדוע מתרחשת צניחת איברי האגן?: Why does pelvic organ prolapse happen?
מה כולל הטיפול הפיזיותרפי (השמרני) בצניח: What does physiotherapy (conservative treatment) for pelvic organ prolapse include?
היות ורצפת האגן משמשת בסיס תומך לאיברי ה: Since the pelvic floor serves as a supporting base for the pelvic and abdominal organs, these can, in some cases, <mark class="hl">descend through the openings in it.</mark> Prolapse usually occurs in women, and takes place through the vagina.
דרך הנרתיק יכולות לצנוח דפנות הנרתיק או: Through the vagina, the vaginal walls or one (or more) of the pelvic organs can prolapse – bladder prolapse, uterine prolapse, rectal prolapse or bowel prolapse. The rectum can prolapse through the anus.
התחושה האופיינית היא של <mark class=\"hl: The typical feeling is <mark class="hl">heaviness or a downward "pull"</mark> in the pelvis or lower abdomen, a feeling of a "lump" or "bulge" in the vagina. The sensations usually get stronger after long standing or walking, coughing, lifting or effort, or toward the end of the day (because the muscles are tired).
הצניחה יכולה להיות מלווה גם בדליפת שתן א: Prolapse may also come with urinary or fecal leakage, difficulty emptying the bladder or bowels, recurrent urinary tract infections, or bleeding / spotting (with uterine prolapse).
מספר גורמים יכולים לתרום (לחוד או ביחד): Several factors can contribute (separately or together) to pelvic organ prolapse –
<span class=\"t-factor__num\" aria-hidde: 01The quality of the connective tissue which depends on genetic tendency
02Age at an older age there is a greater tendency to pelvic organ prolapse
03Sex women suffer from pelvic organ prolapse more than men,

04A lifestyle involving chronic effort that raises the pressure inside the abdomen, and so the pressure on the pelvic organs and the pelvic floor, such as strenuous sport, work that involves carrying heavy loads, straining on the toilet because of constipation or difficulty emptying, chronic cough and so on.
05Medical background conditions such as diabetes, neurological diseases, chronic respiratory diseases, surgery in the pelvis or abdomen
06(In women) obstetric history giving birth to a baby weighing over 3.5 kg, a long pushing stage, instrumental delivery (vacuum or forceps), episiotomy or extensive tears, multiple births
האבחנה הראשונית נעשית בבדיקה גינקולוגית: The initial diagnosis is made in a gynecological examination, preferably by a urogynecologist (in women), or by a proctologist / colorectal surgeon (in men)
בהתאם לממצאים, יחליט הרופא המטפל גם על ע: Depending on the findings, the treating doctor will also decide on further tests, such as functional tests of the bladder and the rectum.
בטיפול הפיזיותרפי מקבלים הדרכה להתרוקנות: In physiotherapy you are taught how to empty correctly on the toilet and practice it in real life, learn how to exercise correctly without loading the pelvic organs, and learn how to strengthen the pelvic floor muscles that support the pelvic organs.
